Bayesian Optimization via Sequential MCMC (In Development)

BOSS_mcmc.Rd

Run a GP-based sequential MCMC algorithm that:

  1. Re-estimates GP length-scale/noise;

  2. Alternate between performing BO (inner_iter steps) and perform MCMC sampling on the current GP surrogate to update BO search region;

  3. Algorithm terminates when successive MCMC samples indicate convergence (by \(\hat{R}\) statistics) and BO has reached modal convergence.

Usage

BOSS_mcmc(
  func,
  update_step = 10,
  max_iter = 50,
  inner_iter = 10,
  MCMC_size = 10000,
  D = 1,
  lower = rep(0, D),
  upper = rep(1, D),
  nu = Inf,
  quad = FALSE,
  noise_var = 1e-06,
  modal_k.nn = 5,
  initial_design = 10,
  delta = 0.01,
  alpha = 0.05,
  acc = 0.25,
  explore_size = 500,
  optim.n = 1,
  optim.max.iter = 1000,
  Rhat_eps = 0.01,
  UCB_prob = 0.1,
  verbose = 1
)

Arguments

func

A function f: [0,1]^D -> R to optimize.

update_step

Integer; how often to refit the GP hyperparameters.

max_iter

Maximum number of BO iterations.

inner_iter

Integer; how often to perform MCMC sampling based on the current surrogate

MCMC_size

Integer; MCMC iterations

D

Input dimension.

lower

Numeric vector of length D giving lower bounds (in original scale).

upper

Numeric vector of length D giving upper bounds.

nu

GP covariance smoothness. \(\nu = \infty\) represents squared-exponential kernel; \(3 < \nu < \infty\) represents the Matern kernel with smoothness \(\lceil\nu\rceil - 1/2\). \(\nu > 3\) is required to ensure convergence properties.

quad

Logical; if FALSE (default), use a zero-mean GP model. If TRUE, fit a linear-plus-quadratic mean model \(\beta_0 + x^\top \beta_1 + (x \otimes x)^\top \beta_2\) alongside the GP.

noise_var

GP observation noise variance.

modal_k.nn

Number of nearest neighbours to compute modal covering.

initial_design

Number of initial points to sample.

delta

Exploration parameter passed to UCB.

alpha

Numeric value between (0,1). Used to determine new search region based on current MCMC sample.

acc

Numeric; accuracy required of the modal exploitation by BO.

explore_size

Integer; how many MCMC sample to use to explore location with the highest surrogate uncertainty.

optim.n

Number of multistart in acquisition optimization.

optim.max.iter

Maxit for length-scale optimization.

Rhat_eps

Numeric; required accuracy to terminate the algorithm based on the \(\hat{R}\) statistics between successive MCMC samples. Default to Rhat_eps = 0.01 to represent a stopping criterion of \(\hat{R} < 1.01\).

UCB_prob

Numeric; probability threshold to indicate the modal convergence from UCB. Default to UCB_prob < 0.1.

verbose

Verbosity level (0–3).

Value

A BOSS object with subclass "boss_mcmc" (S3 class boss_mcmc and boss), which is a list containing:

objective_function

The original objective function f.

D

Input dimension of the objective function.

design_points

List with components x (scaled inputs), x_original (original inputs), and y (responses).

gp_params

List with length_scale and signal_var, the final GP hyperparameters.

surrogate

A function (xvalue) -> numeric giving the GP posterior mean at xvalue.

essential_support

A box specifying the essential support identified by the last MCMC sample.

fill_in

Placeholder for additional outputs (to be computed later).

mcmc_result

List with components sample (MCMC sample from the last iteration), R_hat (\(\hat{R}\) statistics across MCMC-sampling phase.)

modal_result

Data frame of modal-distance diagnostics collected during optimization.
